purpose: Prove mailbox possession without making the People runtime dependent on a specific email vendor.
sequence: Admin or authorized Systemia operator creates an email challenge using the intended raw email address.
People persists only SHA-256(email), masked email hint, challenge token hash, expiry, and challenge state.
A trusted Gmail/Resend transport adapter sends the exact verification URL to the raw email address and must obtain a provider-confirmed sent result containing a provider message reference.

The separate mail adapter signs provider, sent status, provider-issued message reference, challenge key, and destination hash with its private Ed25519 key. The protected delivery-receipt endpoint verifies its signature against an approved public key loaded from owned restricted Compute configuration.
People derives the destination hash from the challenge record and never requires the raw email again.
Only after a qualifying sent receipt exists may redemption of the exact verification token plus VERIFY MY EMAIL upgrade identity assurance to verified_email.
invariants: Manual copy or forwarding does not prove mailbox possession.
A trusted sent receipt without a provider message reference, matching destination hash, and valid provider signature is rejected.
Raw recipient email is not persisted in People state or delivery receipts.
Challenge token is persisted only as SHA-256.
Mail providers are replaceable; private adapter signing keys never reside in People runtime and operator API access alone cannot create a trusted sent receipt.
No verified_email claim exists before both trusted delivery and person redemption.
public_key_configuration: PEOPLE_MAIL_DELIVERY_PUBLIC_KEYS_FILE inside admitted Evercraft Compute root, mode 0600; absent keys mean no trusted email delivery
production_requirement: Only sign after a real provider-send response; tests with mock mail transports never establish real mailbox delivery.
